descriptions.usem.remtask.payload.fields: Fields of a remediation task sent in the outbound Kafka payload (RemediationTaskPayloadBuilder). Comma separated ServiceNow field names, in payload order.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.common: Fields sent to CDP for every remediation task table (CdpRemediationTaskPayloadBuilder). Comma separated; use json_name=field where the JSON key differs from the field name.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.sn_vul_app_vulne: Fields sent to CDP for sn_vul_app_vulnerability in addition to usem.cdp.remtask.fields.common. Comma separated; json_name=field where the JSON key differs. The table is supported only while this property exists.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.sn_vul_container: Fields sent to CDP for sn_vul_container_vulnerability in addition to usem.cdp.remtask.fields.common. Comma separated; json_name=field where the JSON key differs. The table is supported only while this property exists.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.sn_vul_vulnerabi: Fields sent to CDP for sn_vul_vulnerability in addition to usem.cdp.remtask.fields.common. Comma separated; json_name=field where the JSON key differs. The table is supported only while this property exists.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.fields.sn_vulc_result_g: Fields sent to CDP for sn_vulc_result_group in addition to usem.cdp.remtask.fields.common. Comma separated; json_name=field where the JSON key differs. The table is supported only while this property exists.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.changes.sn_vul_app_vuln: Change request association for sn_vul_app_vulnerability as <association table>.<field referencing the remediation task>; feeds change_requests in the CDP payload.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.changes.sn_vul_containe: Change request association for sn_vul_container_vulnerability as <association table>.<field referencing the remediation task>; feeds change_requests in the CDP payload.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.changes.sn_vul_vulnerab: Change request association for sn_vul_vulnerability as <association table>.<field referencing the remediation task>; feeds change_requests in the CDP payload.
descriptions.usem.cdp.remtask.changes.sn_vulc_result_: Change request association for sn_vulc_result_group as <association table>.<field referencing the remediation task>; feeds change_requests in the CDP payload.
